observations.behavior: Adds a new HogFunctionTemplate named HOG_FUNCTION_TEMPLATES_TRANSFORMATIONS_LOG and its constituent templates.

observations.behavior: Adds a HogFunctionTemplate for dropping logs by severity.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines a HogFunctionTemplate for dropping logs by severity, which allows users to filter out logs based on their severity level.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a UI implementation and configuration update. P1.F21.H1 adds a new scene component and banner, while P1.F22.H1 updates the tab configuration. No backend, ingestion, or query execution changes are supplied. The connection to PostHog is the Logs scene, but the tier cannot be established without backend or ingestion changes.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Logs Transformations scene component with a beta banner and lists HogFunction components.
observations.code_quote: Transformations run on every log record as it is ingested. Use them to mutate, redact, or drop records.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a UI entry point for configuring log record transformations, displayed alongside existing Logs scene tabs.

observations.behavior: Adds 'transformations' to the Logs scene active tab configuration and its validation list.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Logs scene to switch to a new tab dedicated to transformations, matching the new component added in P1.F21.
